groups.rationale: Reviewed: Mila client, fonts and optional Android package change no system topology, hosts or deployment placement; chapter 08 rows document client features only.

Reviewed Mila client additions over existing Porsche commands (machine create/resize/clone, share show/add/remove) with no Marshall behaviour change. Chapter 08's Mila table gains Machines (create, resize, clone, sharing) and Type (bundled ADR-0207 Noto fallbacks fetched from Marshall's pinned manifest) rows.

Reviewed: Mila uses existing Porsche command shapes for machine changes and sharing; no protocol change. Chapter 08's Mila table gains Machines (create, resize, clone, sharing) and Type (bundled ADR-0207 Noto fallbacks fetched from Marshall's pinned manifest) rows.

Lilly transfer fixes described in chapter 04 (probe-to-memory-export grant, lease-free RAM stream child, clone copies pull no RAM, per-step source reasons). Reviewed trunk merge: trunk's Windows editor job custodian (ADR-0208), SCIM renumbering to ADR-0229 and its own Notifications config restoration keep their reviewed chapters; conflict resolution keeps one Marshall.Notifications domain entry with the Mila 5-slot queue and one Mila ADR index paragraph.

Reviewed: Mila drives existing Porsche commands only; Porsche unchanged. Chapter 08's Mila table gains Machines (create, resize, clone, sharing) and Type (bundled ADR-0207 Noto fallbacks fetched from Marshall's pinned manifest) rows.

Reviewed Nix/devenv: fonts.nix fetches Marshall's pinned Noto sources by SHA-256 as Mila build inputs, a devenv mila:fonts link serves local runs, and tool-mila-android is an optional client package excluded from CI. None deploys, configures or places a service, so chapters 12/13/14/18/22 are unchanged; Mila features are documented in chapter 08.

Reviewed ADR-0207/0220/0226/0227 evidence and the M6 review follow-up (Noto bundling, Android package, iOS extension target, machine/sharing features). They record client evidence and gaps only; governance chapters 17/19/20/21/22 are unchanged.
